entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Sorry for the last-minute visit.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: How's Yoshizawa-san holding up?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I've been concerned about a potential[n]relapse, considering her difficulties[n]with accepting this reality.
She's just fine.
Sumire's one tough lady.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I see... No, that's great news.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: ...You know, I would love for that to be[n]the truth.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: But, people can't maintain their strength[n]forever, [lName]-kun.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: So... Getting down to business...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I wanted to confirm with you one last[n]time: is there no other way to come[n]to an agreement besides fighting?
We can't accept this reality.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: The reality I created may seem distorted[n]from your point-of-view...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: But it's a reality where everyone[n]is happy.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: If you just stay, you'll never have to suffer[n]the pain of loss, or the pain from having[n]people and things stolen away from you!
Like you have?
What was stolen from you?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: So... You saw what happened with[n]Rumi.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I'm not the one who suffered—she is.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: But, she's still living a wonderful life[n]right now...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: ...In this world you call a "distorted[n]reality."

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But she still doesn't remember you,[n]right? And you're fine with that?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: She may not be in my life anymore, but[n]at least her own life is a happy one now.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I'm not just doing this for Rumi—I want[n]all of you to live just as happily as she is...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: But for Rumi's happiness to last, I have[n]to move on.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: After all that's happened to her—to me—[n]I just can't drag her into it.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Doc...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: My stance will not change.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Strange circumstances have led to my[n]gaining this power—however, I now[n]recognize it as being wholly inevitable.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: This is something only I am capable of[n]doing. I promise: every person alive[n]will be happy in the world I create...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: So let me ask you the same: after really[n]considering every option, do any of you[n]have doubts about your views?
What do you mean?
What are you getting at?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Once somebody experiences their ideal[n]form of happiness, it's extremely difficult[n]to leave that feeling behind.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Enough, Maruki!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We've already made up our minds:[n]we're rejecting your reality!

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Really? The entirety of it?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: ...Consider Akechi-kun.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Selfish adults abused his weakness to[n]do horrible things, culminating in his[n]confrontation with the Phantom Thieves.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: When it was all over...

entries.speaker: Cognitive Akechi
entries.en: You bastard!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: So, my final enemy is a puppet version[n]of myself...
entries.uk: Отже, мій останній ворог — маріонеткова[n]версія мене самого...

entries.speaker: Cognitive Akechi
entries.en: You bastard!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: So, my final enemy is a puppet version[n]of myself...
entries.uk: Отже, мій останній ворог — маріонеткова[n]версія мене самого...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Not bad.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Were you satisfied with what fate[n]dealt you? I can't imagine so.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: That's why I created a reality where[n]you could all have another chance[n]to make it work.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Get what I'm saying?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: If this reality were to disappear, then[n]he could be...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I genuinely didn't want to tell you[n]like this. I didn't want to make it seem[n]like I'm holding him hostage...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: But no matter what you may think of me,[n]I just want you all to accept this reality[n]and move on with your happy lives.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Please...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Please, accept my gift. For your friends'[n]sake and your own!
I can't.
I'll accept it.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: You... you will!? You're going to...[n]Oh, I'm so glad!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey... are you sure?
I need to think it over again.
I'm sure.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Then, I'm going to ask you again:

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Give me your answer.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Oh my... I'm so glad I was able to[n]get through to you!!

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: You don't need to worry about anything[n]now. Just leave the rest to me.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: [lName]-kun...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: ...I see.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: That's just like you, isn't it?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: And you... You were the one person[n]I wanted on my side the most.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: You were the guiding light to my[n]research. You showed me the way so[n]I could make my dream into reality.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I have nothing but gratitude for you—[n]not a single ounce of ill will. All I've[n]wanted was to give you happiness.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: But if this is where we are... then this[n]is where we have to be.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Tomorrow... Tomorrow we summon[n]everything we have—and see whose[n]will for the world is stronger.
This is for you.
You forgot something.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Ah, that's right.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Now it's official... I've heard your calling.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We can't lose—no matter what.
